title: Ford broadcasts 1965-1966 - 12237637
doc_notes: This document is a collection of radio broadcasts and statements by Gerald R. Ford, which includes a specific call for a congressional inquiry into UFO sightings.

encounters.summary: Representative Gerald R. Ford calls for a congressional investigation into a series of UFO sightings in Southern Michigan and other parts of the country.
encounters.quote: I believe Congress should thoroughly investigate the rash of reported sightings of unidentified flying objects in Southern Michigan
